members.name: Gouri Nilakantan Mehta
members.bio:
A celebrated theatre director and arts educator, Gouri co-founded the foundation and currently leads the
creative vision of the festival's performances. With years of
experience mentoring youth in the performing arts, she ensures
that each play staged under the Theatre for Change track
resonates with urgency, beauty, and purpose.

members.name: Jaya George
members.bio: Jaya brings discipline and diligence to the festival's financial planning. With a background in non-profit financial systems, she oversees budget management, compliance, and reporting ensuring the festival remains accountable and sustainable.

members.name: Neeraj Kumar
members.bio: Social entrepreneur, storyteller, and founder of ImmunifyMe, Neeraj brings extensive experience in youth innovation, health tech, and grassroots engagement. As festival director he drives the overall vision, partnerships and creative strategy for the Purple Umbrella Festival.
